tools.name: veracross_list_students
tools.description: List students (person records with grade level, homeroom, household and enrollment status). Data API: GET /students. Scope: students:list.

tools.name: veracross_list_staff_faculty
tools.description: List staff and faculty records (job title, department, faculty type, hire and termination dates). Data API: GET /staff_faculty. Scope: staff_faculty:list.

tools.name: veracross_list_parents
tools.description: List parent and guardian records linked to households. Data API: GET /parents. Scope: parents:list.

tools.name: veracross_list_households
tools.description: List household records (family name and mailing address). Data API: GET /households. Scope: households:list.

tools.name: veracross_list_contact_info
tools.description: List contact details per person (email and phone numbers). Data API: GET /contact_info. Scope: contact_info:list.

tools.name: veracross_list_classes
tools.description: List classes (course, teacher, room, school year, campus and portal visibility). Data API: GET /academics/classes. Scope: academics.classes:list.

tools.name: veracross_list_enrollments
tools.description: List student enrollments in classes (status, date withdrawn, late enrollment date). Data API: GET /academics/enrollments. Scope: academics.enrollments:list.

tools.name: veracross_list_numeric_grades
tools.description: List numeric grades per enrollment and grading period (posted grade, letter grade, lock status, comment). Data API: GET /academics/numeric_grades. Scope: academics.numeric_grades:list.

tools.name: veracross_list_class_assignments
tools.description: List the assignments of one class (type, dates assigned and due, max score, weight). Data API: GET /academics/classes/{internal_class_id}/assignments. Scope: academics.classes.assignments:list.

tools.name: veracross_list_student_assignments
tools.description: List each student's status and raw score on assignments (completion, publish status, private teacher notes). Data API: GET /academics/student_assignments. Scope: academics.student_assignments:list.

tools.name: veracross_list_master_attendance
tools.description: List daily master attendance records per person (student and faculty status, excused, late arrival, early dismissal). Data API: GET /master_attendance. Scope: master_attendance:list.

tools.name: veracross_read_student
tools.description: Get one student record by person id. Data API: GET /students/{id}. Scope: students:read.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: veracross_list_contact_info, veracross_list_numeric_grades · Private data: veracross_list_students, veracross_list_staff_faculty, veracross_list_parents, veracross_list_households, veracross_list_contact_info, veracross_list_student_assignments, veracross_list_master_attendance, veracross_read_student · Public sink: veracross_list_contact_info, veracross_list_student_assignments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: veracross_list_contact_info, veracross_list_numeric_grades · Private data: veracross_list_students, veracross_list_staff_faculty, veracross_list_parents, veracross_list_households, veracross_list_contact_info, veracross_list_student_assignments, veracross_list_master_attendance, veracross_read_student · Public sink: veracross_list_contact_info, veracross_list_student_assignments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
